text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_竜化_ダグザ冥将
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
そういえば、覚えておるぞ……
貴様は確かあの日、唐突に儂の前に現れて……
text.official_en:
Hmm, I remember you. That time you appeared out
of nowhere before me...

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_竜化_ダグザ冥将
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
何だ？　……分からぬ。
分からぬが、貴様は儂の癇に障る……
text.official_en:
Why were you there? Why are you here? For some
reason, I cannot fathom, you make me furious...

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_竜化_ダグザ冥将
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
ほう……奇妙な装束に、奇妙な体術……
貴様ら、さては白き卵の民の生き残りか……！
text.official_en:
Hmm? Those strange outfits and martial arts... You're
the last of the People of the White Egg, aren't you?

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_竜化_ダグザ冥将
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
……ぬう……
多少は……やるようだな……
text.official_en: Grrr... So you can put up...a bit of a fight...

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_トロイア
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
やはり、出たね。
それにしても、冥界の力で竜化とは……
text.official_en:
I should have seen this coming. I just didn't think
he'd draw on the power of the underworld to do it.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_トロイア
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
地下じゃ、アルテミスも使えやしない。
以前のようには行かないね……
text.official_en:
This won't be as simple as last time. We can't use
Artemis underground.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_コウカ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
こんな途方もない相手……
我々だけで、本当に対処できるだろうか……
text.official_en:
Is it really up to us few to deal with an enemy of
his magnitude?

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_フォトナ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
うぬぬ……やはり、
まだ決定的にこちらの頭数が足りぬか……！
text.official_en:
I was right to think our numbers weren't enough
for this fight.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_カイ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
しまった、もう始まっちゃってた！？
誰かがでっかい竜と戦ってる！
text.official_en:
It's already started? Someone's fighting a
huge dragon!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セオドラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
ふん、私としたことが遅れをとったか。
サラミス王セオドラ、これより参戦するぞ！
text.official_en:
Hmph. Am I late to arrive? Regardless, the queen
of Saramis has come to your aid.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ベルトラン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
状況から見て、あれを倒せばいいのだな。
ならば、話が早くて助かるというもの。
text.official_en:
Seems there's no need for a long talk about strategy.
We just take that thing down.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_レダ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
ちょっと、あの白い人って……
あれってもしかして……！？
text.official_en: That white-clad figure... It couldn't be!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ディートリヒ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
冥界の巨竜とは、実に面白い……
久しぶりに……この血が沸き立つというものだ。
text.official_en:
The infernal beast draws me in...my pulse pounds at
the sight of it. It has been too long.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_アナトリア
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
かつての帝都に巣食う悪霊……
祓ってみせます、調停者の名に懸けて！
text.official_en:
Know this, evil spirit. You are an infestation—a
disease. On my honor as Mediator, I will undo you!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_オルヘル
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
もう戦いが始まってしまっているなんて。
わたしもお手伝いしませんと！
text.official_en:
The fighting has already started? I must do my
part!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_タリムーン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
派手にやってるじゃないか、お前さん方！
真打ちは最後に登場……ってね。
text.official_en:
Am I late to the party? Everyone knows the real star
is always last to arrive.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_竜化_ダグザ冥将
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
この儂に挑もうなどと……愚の骨頂よ！
まとめて冥界へ送ってくれるわ！
text.official_en:
It's folly to think you can best me. I'll send every last
one of you to the underworld!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_カイ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
オレ、ずっと待ってたんだ！
あなたとの約束、忘れた事なんてなかったよ！
text.official_en:
I've been waiting. And I haven't forgotten the pact
we made.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_カイ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
こっからはオレも一緒にいくからさ。
頼ってくれていいからね！
text.official_en: I'm with you. You can count on me.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ディートリヒ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
待っていたぞ、お前のことを……
約束は違えなかったな。
text.official_en: I see that you kept your promise. I have awaited you.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ディートリヒ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
成程……この相手は、面白い。
ならば、存分に力を振るえるというもの――！
text.official_en:
You have attracted a compelling opponent. I can let
loose my full strength upon it!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セオドラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
無事、あの日の約束は果たせたようだな。
――来たぞ、私は。
text.official_en:
I have come to honor the promise I made to you
years ago.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セオドラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
我々は、ずっと待っていたのだ。
世界のどこかで反撃の狼煙があがる日を。
text.official_en:
We have long awaited the day when a beacon for the
counterattack would rise somewhere in the world.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_レダ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
あなたには色々と借りがありましたよね？
だから、今日はそれを返しに来ました。
text.official_en:
I know I owe you for everything. I came here today
to pay you back.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_レダ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
……本当のことを言うと、あたし、
待っていたんです。ずっと……あなたのことを。
text.official_en: It's good to see you after all this time.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_トロイア
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
なんて量の瘴気だ……！
しかも、この粘り着くような感覚……
text.official_en: So much miasma...and it sticks to you too.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_トロイア
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp: どうやら、こちらの<#CTRL:0E>
text.official_en: It's clearly a ploy to <#CTRL:0E>

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_コウカ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
くっ、囲まれたか……！
やはり一筋縄ではいかないな。
text.official_en:
We're surrounded. I should have known this wouldn't
be easy.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_フォトナ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
戯け！　だからあれほど言ったではないか……
真焔将を導かねば無理じゃ、と！
text.official_en:
You fool! This is why I harped on about it being
impossible without the Flame Lords!

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_フォトナ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
今回は特別に、吾の力で方尖塔の間へ戻してやろう。
しばし頭を冷やし、出直すが良い！
text.official_en:
I'll do you the favor of using my power to return us to
the Obelisk Chamber. Think before setting out again!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_冥将_ゼンゼル
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
お前は、忘れもしない、私の楽園を奪った小僧！
おのれ……許さんぞ……お前だけは……！
text.official_en:
You. You're the welp who ruined my paradise. I will
never forget you. And I will never forgive you!

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_カイ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
そっか……死んだからって、
おっさんの欲は収まらなかったんだな。
text.official_en: Huh. The old man's greed didn't die with him.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_冥将_ゼンゼル
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
お前も……私の楽園に
描き加えてくれる……！
text.official_en: I'll paint you into the afterlife!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_冥将_ボルボア
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
貴様は……
私から……すべてを奪った女……！
text.official_en: It's you... The woman who took everything from me!

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_レダ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
……別に謝るつもりなんてないけど、
復讐相手と再会するなんて……気まずいわね……
text.official_en:
This is uncomfortable. If you expect an apology for
my taking vengeance, you'll be disappointed.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_冥将_ボルボア
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
ここは……私の領地だ……
それを侵すものは……
text.official_en:
This is my territory. Mine! How dare you
encroach here...

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ヤヌアリウス
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
何をしておる……ネイサン将軍……
敵を討たんか……
text.official_en:
What are you doing, Nathan? Why aren't you killing
my enemies for me?

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ネイサン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
知った顔を斬ることなど慣れているとはいえ
……この相手は少々、意表を突かれたな。
text.official_en:
I've gotten used to killing people I knew in life. This,
however...I was not prepared for.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ヤヌアリウス
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
……貴様までも、儂のことを
裏切りおったか……キリーク将軍……！
text.official_en: Why, Creek? Have even you betrayed me?

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_キリーク
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
俺が期待通りに動かなかったとしても、
その言いようは心外というものだ。将軍。
text.official_en:
My actions may not have been what you expected,
but to call them a "betrayal"? You wound me.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ヤヌアリウス
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
今こそ……バロール様に
儂の働きをお見せするのだ……！
text.official_en: Now's my chance to curry some favor with Balor!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_エスメラルダ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
ダーリン、ねえ……あんたってさ、
昔と同じで、死んじゃってもキレイなんだね。
text.official_en:
Sweetie, you're just like you used to be... Beautiful,
even in death.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_エスメラルダ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
でも、やっぱりあたいは……
ダーリンには一緒に生きてほしかったんだ。
text.official_en:
Really, all I wanted— Oh... All I wanted was for you
to be with me.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_冥将_ディートリヒ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
お前の力……
私に示すがいい……！
text.official_en: Show me your strength!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ブレザ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
――待ちわびたぞ、
お前と刃を交えることが出来る、この時を！
text.official_en:
I've waited so long to cross blades with you,
the one they call a savior.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ブレザ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
救世主とやら、お前の力を
この私に示してみるがいい！
text.official_en: Let's see if you can save yourself!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ブレザ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
……異国の剣士よ。お前は確かに私と似ている。
何よりも戦いを求める、その姿勢が……
text.official_en:
You and I are cut from the same cloth, foreigner.
We both crave battle above all else!

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ディートリヒ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
そうだな……そして、確かめてみるがいい。
私たちの違いがどこにあるのかも……
text.official_en:
We do. We should test each other to see how we
match...and how we differ.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ブレザ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
さあ、来るがよい。
戦士の対話に、無粋な言葉など不要。
text.official_en:
Now, come! Why waste time talking, when we could
be fighting?

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_フォトナ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
この場所を覆う瘴気は
また一段と禍々しいのう……
text.official_en:
The miasma covering this place seems even more
sinister than the last.

text.jp: <#CTRL:0E>
text.official_en: I suspect it will <#CTRL:0E>

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_冥将_アナトリア
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
………………
僕たちの敵……排除……実行します。
text.official_en: Urghhh... Must...eliminate...the enemy.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ナジャ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
アナトリア……おれはさ、
正直、こんな形でおまえと会いたくはなかったぜ。
text.official_en: It's so hard to see you like this, Anatolia...

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ナジャ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
だけど……仕方ねえよな。
こっちも、立ち止まるわけには行かねえからさ。
text.official_en: But I've gotta do what's right.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_冥将_アナトリア
US EN person identifier agrees

text.official_en: Urrrgh... Dadao...

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ダイトウ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
アナトリア……ごめんだぞ。おいら……
やらなくちゃならないことがあるんだ。
text.official_en: I'm sorry, Anatolia. I have to do this.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ハルヴィン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
アナトリアちゃん……あの日助けてもらったこと
私、忘れてなんかいないからね……
text.official_en:
I need you to know, Toli... I'll always remember the
day you saved me.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_冥将_アナトリア
US EN person identifier agrees

text.official_en: Ahhhrgh...

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_冥将_アナトリア
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
僕たちの道を阻む存在など許しません……
排除します……必ず……！
text.official_en:
No one will stand in our way. I will eliminate each
of you without fail!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_シンラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
いい気になるな、何が救世主か。所詮、
獣に味方する歪なものに過ぎないではないか。
text.official_en:
Promised One? Tch. What flattery. You're simply
a delusional mess, siding with the beasts.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_シンラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
お前が真に救世主であるならば、
なぜ、我らのことを救わなかった……！
text.official_en: If you lived up to your title, you'd have saved us!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ファビオ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
話が出来るなら、然るべき場所に帰りなさい。
この地上には本来、亡霊の居場所などないのです。
text.official_en:
Capable of discourse? Then you have the sense to
desist. There is no place in this world for ghosts.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_シンラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
……お前などに、
私達の歩みは止められん……
text.official_en: You cannot stop our advance.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_シンラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
地上にはびこる……
汚らしい……獣どもが！
text.official_en: Hideous beasts, running freely through our world!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_フォトナ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
ここの瘴気は……何やら匂うな。
物を腐らせる、酸の如き香りじゃ……
text.official_en:
The miasma here has quite the odor. It smells of
some sort of corrosive acid.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_フォトナ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
しかも、魔力を吸い取られる感覚がある……
<#CTRL:0E>
text.official_en: It <#CTRL:0E>

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_冥将_ベルトラン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
お前も……敵か。
敵は余すことなく……倒す！
text.official_en:
Another foe stands across me. I will defeat you,
and them, and everyone!

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_マクシム
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
ベルトラン……さようなら。
あなたを乗り越えて、僕は生きます。
text.official_en: Bertrand... Goodbye. I'll survive for you.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_冥将_ベルトラン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
誰であろうと……
生かしてはおかん……
text.official_en: You will not see tomorrow, whoever you are.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ゴライアス
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
兄貴にこんな風になられるとよ……
正直、きついぜ……俺っちは……
text.official_en: Brother, I hate you bein' like this. It's hard to watch.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ダンテ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
悲劇だね。こんな形で
きみと再会することになるなんて……
text.official_en:
I can think of no more tragic end to your story
than this.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_冥将_ベルトラン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.official_en: Rrgh...

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ダンテ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
……ああ、そうだな。何も言わなくていい。
台詞は……ぼくに任せておいてくれ。
text.official_en:
That's alright—no need to speak. I can work out your
dialogue later.

text.jp: <TH>
